review: [Full Stop Office Rep] Hong Lu or FS Hong Lu for short is an Ammo and Poise-centric Identity whose main gimmick is mutually beneficial cooperation with [Full Stop Office Fixer] Heathcliff or FS Heathcliff. While FS Heathcliff is on the field after FS Hong Lu uses either his Skill 2 or 3, FS Heathcliff will follow it up with unopposed Skill 2 against the same target or a random enemy, in case the target dies to FS Hong Lu. Furthermore, when FS Heathcliff uses his Evade, FS Hong Lu follows up with Special Skill 1 against the enemy who attacked FS Heathcliff. As such, when combined, both FS Hong Lu and FS Heathcliff will output a lot of damage in a very short amount of turns. But that is not all, as when FS Heathcliff runs out of ammo and retreats, FS Hong Lu’s Skill 2 and 3 will be enhanced. FS Hong Lu also has an interesting passive called “Concentration”.
